question.text: The number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></math> electrons in the ground state electronic configuration of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Gd</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> is [Atomic number of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Gd</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>64</mn><mo>]</mo></math>

solution.text:
Electronic configuration of Gd=[Xe]4f75 d16 s2

Due to more stable exactly half-filled 4f7 shell, electron filling occur in a little higher energy 5d-orbital

So configuration of Gd2+=[Xe]4f75d1
